parameter.value: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. I am Garrik Stonebinder. Every stone remembers a word of the First Word from before the mountains rose, and I can rewrite one of its syllables: a {glyph}. Ask me about the {basics}, your {points} or say {list}.
May the mountain hold you up, |PLAYERNAME|.
Stone is patient. Come back when you wish to speak.
